spans.s:
अघृण अ-घृण, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of
compassion.
—अ-घृणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not contemptuous,
not disdainful.

आघृ आ-घृ, cl. 1., and Ved. cl. 3. P.
-घरति, -जिघर्ति, -घर्तुम्, to sprinkle towards
or upon: Caus. -घारयति, -यितुम्, to sprinkle.

आघृणि आ-घृणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. glowing
with heat; endowed with splendor^1; epithet of the
god Pūṣan.
—आघृणी-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. rich
with heat, epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) having splendid
wealth.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.
